title: A New Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought everything had settled, the sky suddenly darkened, and an eye burning with golden flames slowly opened from the depths of the clouds—it was the Heavenly Eye's death sentence.

text.content: Awareness rose like from the depths of the sea, and Chen Ji felt himself wrapped in a warm force. As he opened his eyes, what entered his vision was not the expected desolate wilderness but an ancient stone chamber, its walls covered with obscure runes, the air filled with faint sandalwood and herbal scents. 'Awake?' A hoarse yet familiar voice came from beside him. Chen Ji turned his head, meeting Mo Xiansheng's eyes as deep as an abyss. The old man's form was even more ethereal than before, as if he might dissipate in the wind at any moment, yet a meaningful smile played at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: 'When your father entrusted the Tianji Record to me, he said something—'If Ji'er can bear this burden, I hope the master will protect him.' I thought this day would never come,没想到……' Mo Xiansheng's words paused, a complex light flickering in his eyes. 'You surpass even your father.'

text.content: Chen Ji propped himself up, memories flooding back like a tide—the dissipating figure, the ancient confrontation between the dynasty and the Heavenly Eye, and the words 'What awaits you will be an unexpected inheritance.' He下意识地将神识探入识海，触及那本残破的书册。然而下一刻，他的瞳孔suddenly收缩。天机录第四页，那原本空白如雪的书页，此刻竟slowly浮现出金色的纹路，如同久旱逢甘霖的河床，一点一点地被生机填满。

dialogue.content: 'You see it?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried barely concealed excitement. 'When you saved Chen Nian, the Tianji Record acknowledged you. The reason the fragments are incomplete is because they lack a 'Heavenly Fate Person' as their core. And you—' The old man took a deep breath. 'You are that key.' Before his words finished, the runes on the chamber walls suddenly glowed, and a golden light erupted from the Tianji Record, forming a虚幻的画面：那是完整的九页天机录，每一页都散发着截然不同的气息，却又在深处彼此呼应。

text.content: 'The complete Tianji Record……' Chen Ji murmured, his heartbeat accelerating involuntarily. He reached out, his fingertips touching that illusory scene, golden motes of light circling around him like fireflies. An unprecedented sense of completeness filled his entire being, as if a紧闭的大门终于被推开了一道缝隙。Mo Xiansheng watched him quietly, only speaking when the light gradually faded: 'The complete Tianji Record has nine pages, and what you see now is four—this is already great fortune. The remaining five pages……scattered across the world, recovering them is what you must do next.'

Yet Chen Ji had no mind to contemplate fortune at the moment. His gaze swept to the corner of the stone chamber—where a figure lay. 'Nian'er!' He rushed over almost instantly, kneeling on one knee, carefully pulling that frail body into his arms. Chen Nian's face was pale as paper, her breathing so faint it was barely perceptible, but on that face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, the pain and fear from her imprisonment had finally faded. 'Brother……' The girl's eyelashes fluttered slightly, her lips moving, yet only able to produce a breath-like whisper.

dialogue.content: 'I'm here, I'm right here.' Chen Ji's voice was low and gentle, completely different from his usual coldness. He held his sister's hand, feeling that icy temperature, his heart aching. Mo Xiansheng walked to the side and sighed: 'She was cultivated as a 'Heavenly Fate Key' by the Holy Sect for too long, her innate Heavenly Fate power almost completely drained. Surviving is already fortunate—to fully recover……requires massive natural treasures and at least three years of recuperation.' Three years. Chen Ji carved this number into his heart, his expression unchanged.

text.content: 'Three years……' Chen Ji repeated this timeframe quietly, a fierce light flickering in his eyes. The debt owed by the Holy Sect, he would collect it one by one. But now was not the time for rashness—Nian'er needed rest, the Tianji Record needed completion, and that so-called Heavenly Eye's true chess game was only beginning to reveal its tip. The stone chamber door suddenly opened gently, and a black figure silently entered. Chen Ji looked up, meeting eyes both clear and fathomless—it was Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: 'It seems I've arrived at just the right time.' Ye Qing's voice carried her usual languid tone, yet her gaze inevitably fell on the pale girl's face in Chen Ji's arms, a subtle softness flickering in her eyes. She stepped forward, taking a completely black jade bottle from her sleeve, gently placing it beside Chen Ji: 'Demon Yuan Elixir—though it cannot heal her injuries completely, it can suppress the backlash of Heavenly Fate power during recuperation. A secret medicine of the Holy Sect, I had no use for it.' She paused. 'Consider it……a farewell gift.'

text.content: Farewell. This word made Chen Ji pause slightly. He looked up, examining this woman who had fought alongside him. The Demonic Path Saintess's name had once terrified countless people, yet now she had shed that fierce edge, leaving only a faint weariness and relief. 'The Holy Sect matter has spread—作为一个'叛徒'留在中州只会给你招来更多麻烦。Ye Qing turned to face the overcast sky beyond the window. 'I must return to the Demonic Territory—there are still some old scores to settle.'

choice.prompt: As Chen Ji bade farewell to Ye Qing, his heart was filled with countless emotions. How should he respond to this former ally?

choices.description: Making a pact with Ye Qing—when the Tianji Record is complete, the two shall together oppose Heaven
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may take notice of Ye Qing because of this

dialogue.content: 'Destiny Companion……' Ye Qing savored these words, then suddenly laughed softly. 'Chen Ji, you are the most interesting human I've ever met. Very well, I await that day.' She extended her hand, and her palm struck Chen Ji's, the crisp sound echoing in the stone chamber. 'With you as a piece on the Central Plains chessboard, the game becomes worth watching. I look forward to fighting alongside you again.'

text.content: Ye Qing's figure vanished into the night, leaving only a wisp of faint demonic energy dissipating in the air. Chen Ji gazed toward where she had departed, an unprecedented heroic spirit surging in his heart. Did the Heavenly Eye want to make him a piece? Then let's see—who is truly holding the pieces. In his arms, Chen Nian stirred slightly, seemingly sensing her brother's emotional change, the corners of her lips lifting slightly, revealing a relieved smile.

choices.description: Rationally exchanging intelligence with Ye Qing, confirming future contact methods and code words

dialogue.content: 'You're quite composed.' Ye Qing took the intelligence jade slip Chen Ji handed her, her spiritual sense scanning it before tucking it into her sleeve. 'Rest assured, the Demonic Territory's underground network spans the world—if there's urgent matter, someone will contact you.' She glanced at Chen Ji one last time. 'But truly—learn to be a bit more warm occasionally, otherwise that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow will probably die of anxiety.' Before her words finished, she had already turned into a wisp of black smoke, vanishing into the night.

text.content: A faint twitch appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. Su Qingyao? Why mention her at a time like this? He shook his head, casting aside miscellaneous thoughts, lowering his gaze to his sister in his arms. No matter how arduous the road ahead, he would never let Nian'er leave his sight again. Mo Xiansheng's voice适时响起：'接下来，你打算怎么办？'

Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His gaze fell on the残月 half-hidden by乌云 beyond the window, his mind rapidly deducing the chess game ahead. Four pages of the Tianji Record had appeared, the day of completion was foreseeable; Chen Nian was rescued but needed long-term recuperation; Ye Qing returned to the Demonic Territory, echoing from the shadows; and that so-called Heavenly Eye……The dynasty's confrontation with it was far more ancient than imagined. All of this told him one fact—his true opponent was never any Holy Sect or Three Great Sects, but a massive chess game spanning ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: 'What are you thinking?' Mo Xiansheng's voice broke his contemplation. The old man's form grew increasingly ethereal, clearly the刚才激活第四页消耗了他大量的残魂之力。'I'm thinking……' Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voice low yet firm. 'Since Heaven wants to make me a piece, I will overturn this chessboard. It has been setting the game for ten thousand years—I will break the game for ten thousand years.' The moment his words fell, the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea suddenly vibrated violently, the golden runes on the fourth page spreading outward,一行古老的文字浮现在陈机眼前——'天命可违，棋手可换。'

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's revelation gave Chen Ji a decisive judgment. How should he act next?

choices.description: Quietly return to the Tianqing Sect, place Nian'er in a hidden place to recuperate, consolidate the foundation before gradually pursuing the grand cause
choices.visible_reward: Gained tactical advantage 'Stealth Stratagem,' foundation more solid

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, making his decision: 'First let Nian'er recover from her injuries, the rest……can wait.' Mo Xiansheng showed aapproving的神色：'急流勇退，方为上策。I will arrange a concealment formation for you—there is a秘境 in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain that even Ling Yuan doesn't know about, perfect for recuperation.' Chen Ji carefully lifted Chen Nian, feeling that heartbreaking lightness in his arms, his heart secretly swearing: Wait, one day I will let you personally witness a peaceful world.

dialogue.content: 'Brother……' Chen Nian's voice was weak yet carried a hint of relief. 'Nian'er is so tired, but……so happy……' A crystalline tear rolled down from her eye. Chen Ji gently wiped it away, his voice low and gentle: 'Sleep, brother is here, won't let anyone hurt you again.' The girl in his arms finally revealed a浅笑, slowly closing her eyes.

choices.description: Take the initiative to strike, using the fourth page of the Tianji Record to peer into the Heavenly Eye's weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Gained ability 'Heavenly Secrets Foresight,' can predict crises in advance
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is enormous, may cause backlash

text.content: 'No.' Chen Ji shook his head, adetermined的光芒 flickering in his eyes. 'Passively enduring was never my style. Since Heaven is watching me, I will let it see clearly—its piece has begun to bite back.' Before his words finished, he sat cross-legged, hands forming seals, and the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light. Mo Xiansheng's expression大变：'你疯了！Peering into the Heavenly Eye requires far more Heavenly Fate than mortals can withstand—' Yet Chen Ji had already closed his eyes, golden runes spinning madly around him.

In that instant, countless images flooded into Chen Ji's mind like a torrent—he saw the vast earth covered by an eye burning with golden flames; he saw prophetic ones across countless ages who attempted to defy Heaven fall one after another; he also saw a blurry figure in endless darkness murmuring: 'The game……has not……ended……' When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, blood trickled from the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes blazed with unprecedented light—he had seen it, deep within that golden eye, a tiny crack.

That crack, though minute enough to nearly be ignored, truly existed. Chen Ji slowly stood up, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, an indescribable excitement surging in his heart. The Heavenly Eye was not invincible—it too had weaknesses, also had flaws. This was the key to his counterattack. Mo Xiansheng看着陈机那坚毅的侧脸，苍老的面容上浮现出一抹gratified的笑意：'你果然和你父亲一样，从不相信所谓的命运。'

dialogue.content: 'Did Father also peer into the Heavenly Eye?' Chen Ji asked. Mo Xiansheng沉默了片刻，slowly点头：'他看到了同样的裂痕，所以才会拼尽一切将天机录传给你。He wanted his son to complete his unfinished endeavor.' The old man's voice carried several分emotional，'Chen Ji, your father Chen Xuan……he was the most courageous person I've ever met. And you—you are surpassing him.' Beyond the window, the night grew deeper,乌云遮蔽了星光，仿佛有什么巨大的存在正在暗中窥视着这一切。

text.content: Just then, the sky suddenly darkened. The原本被乌云遮蔽的夜空忽然裂开一道缝隙，一只燃烧着金色火焰的眼眸从云层深处slowly显现，dignified而cold地俯视着这片大地。Chen Ji raised his head, gazing into those巨眼，嘴角却勾起一抹冷冽的弧度。'来得真快。' he said quietly. '看来我的窥探……已经触怒了它。' The eye narrowed slightly, and a voice仿佛来自九天之外在所有人脑海中炸响：'蚍蜉撼树，不自量力。'

The golden eye's gaze pressed down like an无形的大山，Chen Ji felt the Heavenly Fate power in his body beginning to剧烈震荡。He gritted his teeth, shielding Chen Nian behind him, not retreating a single step. Mo Xiansheng's残魂在那一刻几乎要被冲散，but he still straightened his spine, standing before Chen Ji. 'It……is warning you.' The old man's voice trembled. 'Telling you not to妄想反抗。' Chen Ji gazed at that高高在上的眼眸，眼底没有丝毫fearful，instead a more blazing fighting spirit ignited. He slowly opened his mouth, his voice light yet clearly reaching every ear: 'If ants can shake trees, let this heaven and earth……witness what a miracle is.'

The moment the words fell, the fourth page of the Tianji Recordsuddenly绽放出耀眼的金光，与那只金色眼眸的光芒遥遥相对。僵持了片刻，那只眼眸终于slowly闭上，消失在云层深处。夜色重归寂静，但所有人都知道——this is merely the calm before the storm. The Heavenly Eye has noticed Chen Ji's existence, and a great storm sweeping the entire cultivation world is about to arrive。Chen Ji lowered his head toward the sleeping Chen Nian in his arms, gently stroking her hair, his voice low yet firm: 'Nian'er, wait. Brother will make this world……change the sky.'
